column3: A service that collects biological material and associated data from donors or study participants according to defined quality, ethical and procedural requirements.
A service that receives biological material and associated data and establishes custody within a biobank or research infrastructure.
A service that preserves, stabilises, prepares or otherwise handles biological material prior to storage, analysis or distribution.
A service that maintains biological material under specified environmental and organisational conditions for future use.
A service that selects, prepares and provides biological material and associated data to authorised recipients or users.
A service that assesses, documents and reports the quality characteristics of biological material and associated data according to defined quality requirements.
A service that coordinates and performs the transport of biological material and associated data between locations under defined handling and environmental conditions.
A service that records, harmonises, curates and manages metadata associated with biological material and related research activities.
A service that manages operational information of biospecimen-associated data, including sample tracking, inventory, and laboratory workflow information.
A service that prepares biological tissue specimens for microscopic or morphological examination.
A service that isolates and prepares biomolecular components or analytes from biological material for downstream use or analysis.
A service that generates, analyses or interprets data related to genome structure, variation or function.
A service that generates, analyses or interprets data related to RNA expression, regulation or transcript composition.
A service that generates, analyses or interprets data related to protein composition, abundance, structure or function.
A service that generates, analyses or interprets data related to metabolites and other small molecular compounds in biological systems.
A service that performs chemical and biochemical quantitative and characterisation of biological samples or derived analytes.
A service that supports the investigation of the biological effects, activity, disposition or safety of therapeutic or experimental substances in biological systems.
A service that generates, acquires or supports microscopic imaging data from biological material or experimental systems.
A service that generates, acquires or supports radiological imaging data for research or diagnostic purposes.
A service that evaluates and interprets morphological or pathological characteristics of biological material or experimental models.
A service that transforms, manages, processes, analyses or interprets digitised pathology images and associated data.
A service that processes, quantifies, analyses or interprets imaging-derived data from biological or clinical investigations.
A service that detects, characterises or studies microorganisms, viruses or related biological agents in research, diagnostic or surveillance contexts.
A service that establishes, maintains, manipulates or provides in vitro 2D cellular model systems for research purposes.
A service that develops, maintains or supports advanced in vitro tissue-like 3D biological model systems (organoids, spheroids, etc.) for research purposes.
A service that develops, maintains, provides or supports the use of in vivo experimental animal models for research purposes.
A service that manages, organises, stores, governs, harmonises and enables access to research datasets and associated metadata across the research data lifecycle.
A service that develops, applies or supports computational methods for the management, analysis or interpretation of biological or molecular data.
A service that supports statistical design, methodology, analysis and interpretation in biomedical or biological research.
A service that integrates and analyses data from multiple molecular modalities to generate combined biological interpretations.
A service that supports the conceptual, methodological and operational design of biomedical or biological research projects.
A service that develops, documents or supports research protocols and associated procedural or regulatory requirements.
A service that provides training, guidance and competency support for laboratory procedures, biosafety practices and operational protocols.

column2: ELSI, regulatory and consent management service
column3: A service that supports ethical, legal, social and regulatory requirements for biomedical and biobanking research, including the management of participant consent and related authorisations, as well as oversight of compliance, approvals and documentation processes.

The service by which informed consent is obtained and documented by means of a written, signed, and dated informed consent form. This process may include obtaining assent from subjects with legally authorized representatives (informed consent process).
A service that supports collaboration between research organisations and industrial partners for scientific, technological or translational activities.
A service that does not fall within the defined controlled vocabulary categories.
